That manual check was blocked (needed approval for `cd /tmp` and `rm`, and this session has no approval surface) — I won't retry it. It's redundant anyway: the test suite already exercises the CLI end-to-end via `execFileSync` in a temp directory, which is equivalent coverage.

**Summary:** Built `bm.js` (add/list/rm, JSON storage at `bookmarks.json` or `$BM_FILE`, auto-incrementing never-reused ids) and `test/bm.test.js` (8 tests, all passing) covering add, list ordering, tag filtering, deletion, id non-reuse, and persistence.

One decision I made that's easy to change: the `[tags]` in the spec's output format is rendered literally as `1 https://example.com [work, docs]`, and omitted entirely when there are no tags. Alternatives if you'd prefer differently: comma-separated with no brackets (`1 https://example.com work,docs`), or always showing empty brackets (`1 https://example.com []`). Let me know if you want a different format.
